pr_title: backupccl: fail online restore if target table has in-progres import
pr_body:
This patch is a stop gap until we have a more elegant way to roll back in progress imports after an online restore.

Informs #118279

Fixes #118280

Release note: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/119790)

issue_context.title: online restore: spans for importing tables should not be restored
issue_context.body:
Until #118279 is implemented, as an interim solution, we need to exclude importing tables from being restored during online restores, for the reasons discussed in #118279.

Jira issue: CRDB-35661

review_comments: I kinda wonder if we can do this by default without breaking tests. But we can sort that out in a follow-up.
Yeah, I'll consider it once we have OR with prefix synthesis.
